ja418:1.1: Idaṃ pure ninnam āhu bahumacchaṃ mahodikaṃ, āvāso bakarājassa pettikaṃ bhavanaṃ mama, ty-ajja bhekena yāpema, okaṃ na vijahāmase ti.
ja418:2.1: Ko dutiyaṃ asīlassa Bandhurass' akkhi bhejjati, ko me putte kulāvañ ca mañ ca sotthiṃ karissatīti
ja418:3.1: Sabbā parikkhatā pheggu yāva tassā gati ahu, khīṇabhakkho mahārāja sāre na ramatī guṇo ti.
ja418:4.1: Sā nūnāhaṃ ito gantvā rañño muttā nivesanā attānaṃ ramayissāmi dumasākhāniketinīti.
ja418:5.1: So nūnāhaṃ ito gantvā rañño mutto nivesanā aggodakāni pissāmi yūthassa purato vajan
ja418:6.1: ti. Taṃ maṃ kāmehi sampannaṃ rattaṃ kāmesu mucchitaṃ ānayi Bharato luddo bāhiyo, bhaddam atthu te ti.
ja418:7.1: Andhakāratimissāya tuṅge upari pabbate sā maṃ saṇhena mudunā mā pādaṃ khaṇi-y-asmanīti.
ja418:8.1: Asaṃsayaṃ jātikhayantadassī na gabbhaseyyaṃ punar āvajissaṃ, ayaṃ hi me antimā gabbhaseyyā, khīṇo me saṃsāro punabbhavāyā 'ti.
